latestTale.title: First Arrival
latestTale.body: The Sunken Fountain waits inside The Salt-Touched Ward. Your first true perception arrives through sight: A dry footprint at the edge of a fountain that has been underwater for years.. People keep their distance, not because they know what you are, but because the world seems to notice you first.
